beats.label: S1 · The recruitment
beats.text: Speedster A-Train kills Hughie's girlfriend in a hit-and-run. Vigilante Billy Butcher recruits the grieving Hughie to expose Vought's superheroes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The origin of the show's central duo and its premise.

beats.label: S1 · Starlight arrives
beats.text: Aspiring hero Annie January joins Vought's Seven as Starlight and is sexually blackmailed by teammate the Deep on her first day.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Annie and the corruption inside the Seven.

beats.label: S1 · Killing Translucent
beats.text: Butcher's crew captures the invisible supe Translucent. Hughie detonates a bomb inside him, and the Boys become hunted fugitives.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns the Boys into criminals and commits Hughie to the fight.

beats.label: S1 · Hughie and Annie
beats.text: Hughie meets Annie by chance and they start dating, each hiding their war from the other; Butcher orders Hughie to keep bugging her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the romance that anchors every season after.

beats.label: S1 · Compound V
beats.text: The Boys discover Compound V — superpowers are manufactured. Vought has secretly injected the drug into infants for decades to seed new heroes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's biggest secret and the seed of every later exposé.

beats.label: S1 · Becca
beats.text: Butcher tells Hughie that Homelander raped his wife Becca, who then vanished. The crusade against Vought is Butcher's personal vendetta.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the real engine behind Butcher's every decision.

beats.label: S1 · The reveal
beats.text: Butcher straps a bomb to Vought VP Madelyn Stillwell to bait Homelander, who kills her himself. He then reveals Becca is alive, hidden with his son.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Detonates Butcher's grief-premise and launches the S2 hunt for Ryan.

cliffhanger.text: Butcher's entire crusade was built on Becca being dead. Homelander has just revealed she is alive, raising his superpowered son in secret — while the Pentagon has declared the Boys fugitives and Compound V a controlled substance.
questions: What will Homelander do now that he knows his son exists?
Can Butcher save Becca without her — and her boy — becoming weapons?
Who is behind the manufactured superpowered terrorists Vought is using to lobby the military?

characters.name: Billy Butcher
characters.line: Leader of the Boys, driven by revenge against Homelander for the loss of his wife Becca — who he has just learned is alive.

characters.name: Hughie Campbell
characters.line: Grieving civilian recruited by Butcher; has killed a superhero and is secretly dating Starlight.

characters.name: Annie January / Starlight
characters.line: Idealistic newcomer to the Seven, sexually assaulted by the Deep, secretly close to Hughie.

characters.name: Homelander
characters.line: Sociopathic leader of the Seven; has just discovered his son by Becca is alive and hidden from him.

characters.name: Frenchie
characters.line: Butcher's tactics and weapons man; formed a wordless bond with the rescued super-woman Kimiko.

characters.name: Mother's Milk (M.M.)
characters.line: Butcher's meticulous former partner, back running surveillance for the Boys.

characters.name: Kimiko / The Female
characters.line: Mute Japanese superpowered woman, freed from captivity by the Shining Light Liberation Army.

characters.name: A-Train
characters.line: Seven speedster who killed Hughie's girlfriend; on the brink of death from a Compound V heart attack.

characters.name: Queen Maeve
characters.line: Veteran of the Seven, disillusioned after Homelander lets a hijacked plane crash to buy political leverage.

characters.name: The Deep
characters.line: Seven member quietly exiled to Ohio after Starlight's assault becomes public.

beats.label: S2 · Fugitives and Stormfront
beats.text: The Boys are hunted fugitives after Stillwell's murder. Vought adds a new hero, Stormfront, to the Seven and she rapidly usurps Homelander's popularity.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's power imbalance inside the Seven.

beats.label: S2 · Homelander finds Ryan
beats.text: Homelander forces his way into the hidden home of Becca and their son Ryan, determined to become the boy's father and mould him into a superhero.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Starts the Ryan-as-successor arc that carries through the whole series.

beats.label: S2 · Compound V goes public
beats.text: Annie leaks a Compound V sample; the world learns superpowers were manufactured by Vought and quietly injected into babies for decades.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Detonates Vought's central lie in public — the ground for every later scandal.

beats.label: S2 · Nazi widow
beats.text: The Boys discover Stormfront is Vought founder Frederick Vought's Nazi widow and the first Compound V subject; she and Homelander begin a sexual, ideological alliance.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames the season's villainy and radicalises Homelander further.

beats.label: S2 · Maeve's blackmail
beats.text: Maeve secretly obtains footage of Homelander abandoning a hijacked airliner to die, and uses it to blackmail him into leaving the Boys alone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The leash that will keep Homelander muzzled into S3.

beats.label: S2 · Ryan kills Becca
beats.text: At Homelander's cabin, Stormfront attacks Becca; Ryan's uncontrolled eye lasers cripple Stormfront but kill his mother. The CIA takes Ryan in.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The tragedy that shapes Ryan, Butcher and Homelander's competition for him.

beats.label: S2 · Neuman revealed
beats.text: Stormfront's Nazi past leaks and the Boys are cleared. Hughie joins Congresswoman Victoria Neuman's staff, unaware she is the head-popping assassin killing witnesses.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the show's political villain and Hughie's blind spot.

cliffhanger.text: Becca is dead by Ryan's own hand and the traumatised boy is now in CIA custody. Homelander is muzzled only by Maeve's airliner blackmail, and Hughie has just walked into a Congresswoman's office not knowing she is the secret head-popping assassin.
questions: Can Butcher and Homelander share the same air with Ryan between them?
What does Neuman intend to do with a government seat and lethal powers?
How long can Maeve's blackmail keep Homelander in check before he snaps?

characters.name: Billy Butcher
characters.line: Grieving Becca and now legally cleared, with Ryan taken into CIA custody.

characters.name: Hughie Campbell
characters.line: Left the Boys for a straight job on Neuman's Congressional staff, unaware of who she really is.

characters.name: Annie January / Starlight
characters.line: Publicly reinstated to the Seven, secretly running intel and Compound V samples to the Boys.

characters.name: Homelander
characters.line: Publicly still the Seven's face but privately muzzled by Maeve's plane footage; has lost Ryan to state custody.

characters.name: Ryan
characters.line: Homelander's superpowered son, orphaned in CIA custody after accidentally killing his mother.

characters.name: Victoria Neuman
characters.line: Anti-Vought Congresswoman and secret superpowered head-popping assassin; Hughie's new boss.

characters.name: Stormfront
characters.line: Nazi supe and Vought founder's widow, publicly exposed and physically crippled by Ryan.

characters.name: Queen Maeve
characters.line: Holds Homelander's airliner footage as blackmail; separated from her ex Elena but now openly out.

characters.name: Mother's Milk (M.M.)
characters.line: Steady operational core of the Boys, key to bringing Stormfront down.

characters.name: Frenchie
characters.line: Boys operative and Kimiko's partner in all but name; carries guilt for the Female's captivity.

characters.name: Kimiko
characters.line: Boys operative whose younger brother Kenji was murdered by Stormfront this season.

beats.label: S3 · Legit contractors
beats.text: One year later, the Boys work as sanctioned contractors under Neuman's Bureau of Superhuman Affairs. Homelander grows petulant and unstable under Vought's leash.
beats.whyLoadBearing: New status quo — Boys are legal and Homelander is publicly restrained, for now.

beats.label: S3 · V24
beats.text: Vought secretly develops V24, a temporary superpower drug. Maeve recruits Butcher to hunt an anti-Homelander weapon; Butcher begins injecting himself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: V24 both empowers and eventually kills Butcher — the season's slow poison.

beats.label: S3 · Soldier Boy
beats.text: The Boys find Soldier Boy alive in a Russian lab, betrayed decades ago by his own team Payback. His blasts depower Supes, and Butcher allies with him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's superweapon and Butcher's chosen tool against Homelander.

beats.label: S3 · Herogasm
beats.text: An empowered Butcher, Hughie and Soldier Boy nearly kill Homelander at the Supe orgy 'Herogasm'. Homelander escapes before Soldier Boy can drain his powers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's failed decapitation attempt; proves Homelander can be threatened.

beats.label: S3 · Father and son
beats.text: Soldier Boy phones Homelander and reveals he is his biological father. Homelander finds Ryan, reconciles with him, and pulls him toward the coming fight.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes Homelander's identity and pits Ryan against Butcher's plan.

beats.label: S3 · Ryan chooses Homelander
beats.text: When Soldier Boy attacks Homelander at Vought Tower, Ryan defends his father. Maeve tackles Soldier Boy in apparent sacrifice; Homelander leaves with his son at his side.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Ryan tug-of-war is decided for now, and Maeve is removed from the board.

beats.label: S3 · New order
beats.text: Butcher is terminally ill from V24 and Annie joins the Boys. Soldier Boy is placed in government custody, and Neuman becomes VP running mate for Bob Singer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the S4 clocks: Butcher's mortality and Neuman's climb to power.

cliffhanger.text: Homelander is now openly killing critics at rallies to public applause, with Ryan at his side. Neuman has been named Bob Singer's Vice-Presidential pick, Soldier Boy is in a government freezer, and Butcher has been told he has months to live.
questions: Can Ryan be pulled back from Homelander before he becomes his father?
Will Neuman ride Singer's ticket all the way into the White House?
What will a dying Butcher be willing to do in the time he has left?

characters.name: Billy Butcher
characters.line: Dying from V24 tumours after months of abusing it; has lost Ryan to Homelander.

characters.name: Hughie Campbell
characters.line: Reconciled with Annie after his own V24 dependence; back with the Boys.

characters.name: Annie January
characters.line: Publicly quit the Seven and denounced Vought on livestream; now formally one of the Boys.

characters.name: Homelander
characters.line: Fully unbound after a career-saving public rant, openly killing dissenters with his son cheering.

characters.name: Ryan
characters.line: Firmly on Homelander's side after his father protected him at Vought Tower.

characters.name: Victoria Neuman
characters.line: Now VP nominee on Bob Singer's presidential ticket; secretly still a head-popping Supe.

characters.name: Mother's Milk (M.M.)
characters.line: Rejoined and now again leads the Boys, having gotten his revenge on Soldier Boy's watch.

characters.name: Frenchie
characters.line: Reunited romantically with Kimiko.

characters.name: Kimiko
characters.line: Powers restored by Compound V after she briefly, joyfully lost them.

characters.name: A-Train
characters.line: Alive on Blue Hawk's transplanted heart; still nominally on the Seven but visibly cracking.

beats.label: S4 · Failed hit
beats.text: The CIA orders the Boys to assassinate Vice-Presidential candidate Neuman, but the mission collapses. Butcher is diagnosed with six months to live from his V24 tumour.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's political stakes and Butcher's countdown clock.

beats.label: S4 · Sage's Seven
beats.text: Homelander recruits the genius Sister Sage and alt-right star Firecracker to the Seven. Sage replaces Ashley as CEO and starts engineering Homelander's takeover.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's real strategist and the coup she is quietly building.

beats.label: S4 · Ryan on live TV
beats.text: Ryan's first scripted public rescue turns disastrous when Homelander goes off-script on live TV and shocks him into killing the stuntman playing the criminal.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cracks the father-son bond Homelander has been building since S2.

beats.label: S4 · The virus and the tumour
beats.text: The Boys work with scientist Sameer on a virus that can kill Supes. Butcher's ally 'Kessler' and dead wife Becca turn out to be hallucinations from his brain tumour.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the anti-Supe superweapon and shows Butcher's judgement failing.

beats.label: S4 · Hugh Sr.
beats.text: Hughie's father is revived with Compound V, turns senile and murders hospital staff; Hughie is forced to mercy-kill him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The personal cost that hardens Hughie against Compound V for good.

beats.label: S4 · Neuman falls
beats.text: Homelander exposes Neuman as a Supe on live TV. She runs to Hughie for protection, but Butcher murders her with newly-grown tendril powers and takes the virus.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the political villain and reveals Butcher has become one too.

beats.label: S4 · Martial law
beats.text: Speaker Calhoun is made President under Homelander and declares martial law. Most Boys are jailed, Annie escapes, and Homelander is told where Soldier Boy is held.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Hands America to Homelander and teases the S5 return of Soldier Boy.

cliffhanger.text: Homelander now effectively rules America through his puppet President Calhoun, with martial law in force and most of the Boys jailed. Butcher has vanished with the Supe-killing virus and new tendril powers of his own, while Homelander has just been shown where a frozen Soldier Boy is being kept.
questions: Will Butcher use the virus in a way that kills all Supes, not just Homelander?
Can a scattered resistance form under Homelander's open dictatorship?
Why does Homelander want a father he already tried to kill unfrozen?

characters.name: Billy Butcher
characters.line: Terminal, hallucinating, and openly genocidal; carrying both the virus and new tendril powers.

characters.name: Hughie Campbell
characters.line: Broken by his father's death and by having to mercy-kill him.

characters.name: Annie January
characters.line: The only Boy still free, with her powers regained after being imprisoned.

characters.name: Homelander
characters.line: Effective ruler of the country through his puppet President; has just learned Soldier Boy's location.

characters.name: Ryan
characters.line: Killed Colonel Mallory by accident and, disillusioned with both sides, walked away from Butcher.

characters.name: Mother's Milk (M.M.)
characters.line: Briefly handed leadership back to Butcher, now captured with most of the Boys.

characters.name: Frenchie
characters.line: Kimiko's partner; freed from jail to work the virus with Sameer.

characters.name: Kimiko
characters.line: Was infected with the Supe-killing virus and had a leg amputated by Frenchie to save her life.

characters.name: Sister Sage
characters.line: Genius who briefly ran Vought as CEO; expelled from the Seven for hiding A-Train but still Homelander's strategist.

characters.name: Firecracker
characters.line: Alt-right Supe on the Seven who publicly destroyed Starlight's reputation.

characters.name: Ashley Barrett
characters.line: Demoted Vought figurehead who injected herself with Compound V during Homelander's purge.

beats.label: S5 · The leak
beats.text: A year into Homelander's rule, Annie leaks the Flight 37 footage of him abandoning a hijacked plane to die, cracking his god-persona in public.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First real chip in Homelander's cult of personality since he took power.

beats.label: S5 · Camp rescue
beats.text: Butcher, Annie and Kimiko break the imprisoned Boys out of a 'freedom camp'. A-Train buys Hughie's escape and is chased down and killed by Homelander.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the Boys back in play and clears a longstanding character off the board.

beats.label: S5 · Soldier Boy returns
beats.text: Homelander revives Soldier Boy from cryostasis and puts him on a rebuilt Seven. His Compound V variant, V1, is discovered to grant immortality.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's macguffin and the object of Homelander's fixation.

beats.label: S5 · Sage defects
beats.text: Homelander becomes obsessed with acquiring V1. Sage defects when he blocks her plan for an apocalyptic Supe-versus-human war, and helps the Boys hunt the vials.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits Vought's brain trust and gives the Boys their pivotal inside ally.

beats.label: S5 · Immortal god
beats.text: Soldier Boy hands the last V1 to Homelander instead of the Boys; he injects, becomes immortal, kills puppet President Calhoun and refreezes Soldier Boy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Homelander's last vulnerabilities and drops the last political fiction.

beats.label: S5 · Kimiko's weapon, Frenchie's cost
beats.text: Frenchie and Sage stabilise a treatment giving Kimiko Soldier Boy's Supe-nullifying blast. Homelander raids the base and Frenchie dies buying the others time to escape.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Forges the only weapon that can strip Homelander, at the cost of a founding Boy.

beats.label: S5 · The Oval Office
beats.text: The Boys storm the White House. Ryan helps restrain Homelander; Kimiko depowers him and Butcher executes him. Butcher then tries to release the virus, and Hughie shoots him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The series-ending double kill: the tyrant, then the man who became one to stop him.

cliffhanger.text: Homelander and Butcher are both dead — Butcher shot by Hughie to stop him unleashing a plague that would have killed every Supe on Earth. The Boys have disbanded: M.M. has adopted Ryan and remarried, Kimiko has moved to France, and Hughie and Annie are expecting a child.
questions: Can the world govern superheroes now that Vought stands restored under Edgar?
What kind of man will Ryan grow into, raised by M.M. after everything he was raised to be?
Has Vought's cycle of manufactured heroes actually ended, or only paused?

characters.name: Billy Butcher
characters.line: Dead, shot by Hughie at Vought Tower to stop him releasing a virus that would have wiped out all Supes.

characters.name: Hughie Campbell
characters.line: Killed Butcher to save the world; expecting a child with Annie.

characters.name: Annie January
characters.line: Powers restored; leaves the fight to raise a child with Hughie.

characters.name: Homelander
characters.line: Dead — briefly immortal via V1 before Kimiko depowered him and Butcher executed him in the Oval Office.

characters.name: Ryan
characters.line: Rejected Butcher's revenge crusade, refused to become Homelander, and is being raised by M.M.

characters.name: Mother's Milk (M.M.)
characters.line: Adopted Ryan and renewed his marriage vows; the Boys are disbanded on his watch.

characters.name: Frenchie
characters.line: Dead, sacrificed to buy the others time to escape Homelander's raid on their base.

characters.name: Kimiko
characters.line: Carries Soldier Boy's Supe-nullifying blast; moved to France after the war ended.

characters.name: Soldier Boy
characters.line: Back in cryogenic stasis after handing V1 to Homelander instead of leaving with it.

characters.name: Sister Sage
characters.line: Voluntarily depowered by Kimiko's blast and walked away to live an ordinary life.
